purpose: Moves through a result set that spans several pages: First / Previous, numbered pages with ellipses, Next / Last. Use it below long tables and lists.

notFor.case: Results that fit on one page.
Loading more rows into the same list.
The steps of a linear flow.
Showing where a page sits in a hierarchy.

Default.visual: compact-grouped: joined like a ButtonGroup; compact: ghost buttons set apart. Size cascades to every link and the ellipsis.

a11y.keyboard: Tab moves through the arrows and the page links; Enter or Space activates. First / Previous are disabled on page 1 and Next / Last on the last page.
notes: nav aria-label="pagination"; the current page is aria-current="page"; the arrows carry aria-labels.
The current page is never marked by colour alone.
